files.description: Primary EHI export documentation. 14-page PDF (December 2023) describing the per-patient ZIP export: file contents, 27 document categories, and field-level data dictionary for 5 export files (Chart Cover Report.xlsx, Entire Patient Chart Report.xlsx, Health Summary Report.xlsx, Referral Authorization Report.xlsx, Trial Balance Report.rtf).

FHIR R4 API documentation (April 2024, 76 pages). This is the (g)(10) standardized API docs, NOT the (b)(10) EHI export. Included for comparison to show that CGM eMDs has separate mechanisms for (g)(10) and (b)(10). Covers US Core FHIR resources: AllergyIntolerance, Binary, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Goal, Immunization, Location, Medication, MedicationRequest, Observation, Organization, Patient, Practitioner, Procedure, Provenance, ServiceRequest.
Screenshot of the expanded Certifications accordion showing all document links including the 'EHI EXPORT DOCUMENTATION' button, taken from the product page.

Bun TypeScript enrichment script that extracts the EHI export data dictionary from the PDF into structured JSON. Parses document categories, export file specifications, field-level details, and coverage statistics.

Structured JSON extraction of the EHI export data dictionary: 27 document categories, 5 export files, 28 field sections, 162 total fields with names and data types, export format metadata, and coverage statistics.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input/output descriptions, known parsing limitations.
